author: Filmento
description:
Clayface might be in theaters right today, but DC already made their biggest monstrosity movie all the way back in 2017: Justice League. They replaced Zack Snyder with Joss Whedon mid-production, which turned the result into a hot mess of different things. So today let's learn from that: what to avoid when molding a big blockbuster production from one shape to another.
